research_scope: Base-game Parallel Quest skills from PQ 56-60 selected after duplicate screening against the canonical skill index and prior research batches.

verification_audit.method: Skill identity, class, core cost data, and PQ acquisition routes were reconciled against current Xenoverse 2 skill references and independent PQ reward guides. Exact drop probabilities and version-sensitive frame data were not inferred.
verification_audit.accuracy_note: Ultimate Finish requirements are intentionally unresolved. The earlier false values were not supported by explicit negative Ultimate-Finish evidence and have been changed to null.

records.name: Stone Bullet
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 56 — Hercule Is Number One; reward
records.skill_description: Throw a series of stones at the opponent; holding the input extends the projectile range.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Stone Bullet as Goten's Strike Super, costing 100 Ki and obtainable from PQ56. Up to 22 stones can be thrown in one use and charging extends range; exact current damage scaling is not promoted as universal.
records.combo_notes: The move is projectile-like despite being classified as a Strike Super; detailed hit-stun and combo routes remain outside the verified scope.
records.pve_notes: Its chargeable range gives it a distinctive harassment option against AI targets.
records.pvp_notes: Range changes substantially with charging, so neutral applications should distinguish uncharged and charged use.

records.name: Rakshasa's Claw
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 57 — Hell Is a Picture?; reward
records.skill_description: Launch directional sword-like energy slashes, then teleport to the opponent for a final overhead strike.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Rakshasa's Claw as Janemba's Strike Super, costing 100 Ki. Repeated inputs produce multiple slices before the teleporting finishing slash; exact current damage and frame data are not promoted as universal.
records.combo_notes: Directional control during the slash sequence is a defining property and should be documented separately from generic rush-skill routes.
records.pve_notes: The ranged opening and teleporting finisher provide flexible positioning against AI targets.
records.pvp_notes: Directional slash control can affect spacing and approach angles; precise punish windows remain version-sensitive.

records.name: Force Shield
records.skill_description: Creates a barrier that cancels incoming Ki waves; holding the input maintains the barrier while consuming Ki.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Force Shield as a Ki Blast Evasive using 200 stamina. The barrier can be maintained by holding the input and rapidly drains Ki while active; exact invulnerability timing is not asserted.
records.combo_notes: Primarily a defensive barrier rather than a conventional evasive attack; maintenance cost should be documented alongside activation cost.
records.pve_notes: Can negate incoming Ki-wave pressure while the user's Ki resource permits continued maintenance.
records.pvp_notes: The barrier's resource drain and limited defensive role make timing important; exact matchup-specific interactions require testing.

records.name: Dimension Cannon
records.character_source: Super Buu; Omega Shenron (Customize Partner); Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed) (Customize Partner)
records.skill_description: Fires a short-range Ki wave from the mouth that knocks opponents away and can break guard when it hits a blocking opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Dimension Cannon as a Ki Blast Evasive costing 300 stamina. It is a six-hit wave with guard-break behavior against blocking opponents; exact current damage and invulnerability timing remain unresolved.
records.combo_notes: Its guard-break property distinguishes it from a simple escape evasive, but detailed punish and combo routes require separate testing.
records.pve_notes: The guard-break behavior can matter against defensive AI and the wave creates immediate space after activation.
records.pvp_notes: The guard interaction is a significant documented property, while exact startup, invulnerability, and punish windows remain version-sensitive.

records.name: Majin Kamehameha
records.character_source: Majin Buu (Good); Super Buu; Kid Buu; Android 21; Majin CaCs
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 60 — Blast the Super Spirit Bomb!; reward
records.skill_description: A pink Kamehameha that can be charged through three stages, increasing the number of hits and overall output.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Majin Kamehameha as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super usable by Majin characters and Majin CaCs. It has three charge stages; exact current damage scaling is documented by the source but is not treated as universal across versions.
records.combo_notes: The charge stages create distinct timing and resource considerations compared with the standard Kamehameha.
records.pve_notes: Its chargeable beam provides flexible damage timing in PvE when the player has room to charge.
records.pvp_notes: Charging increases commitment and exposure, so the three stages should be documented separately from the uncharged cast.
